name: Greencycled Storage Jars | Set of 2 | 250 ml each
shortStory: Thoughtfully crafted from upcycled glass, these storage jars feature wooden lids with airtight silicone seals to help maintain freshness. Perfect for storing nuts, spices, cookies and everyday kitchen essentials, they bring a natural, minimalist touch to your kitchen.
description: Thoughtfully crafted from upcycled glass, these storage jars feature wooden lids with airtight silicone seals to help maintain freshness. Perfect for storing nuts, spices, cookies and everyday kitchen essentials, they bring a natural, minimalist touch to your kitchen.

sections.title: Product Features
sections.content:
• Material: Upcycled wine bottle glass, wooden lids and silicone seals
• Capacity: 250 ml per jar (9 cm height)
• Set Includes: 2 storage jars with wooden lids
• Airtight Seal: Helps maintain freshness when properly closed
• Versatile Storage: Ideal for nuts, spices, cookies and other kitchen essentials
• Reusable: Designed for everyday use
• Dimensions: 17.5 × 9 × 11.5 cm (set dimensions)
• Net Weight: 590 g per set of 2
• Shipping: Dispatched within 2–3 working days

sections.title: Care Instructions
sections.content:
• Handwash only using mild dishwashing liquid.
• Avoid harsh scrubbers and chemicals.
• Wipe dry thoroughly after washing.
• Keep wooden lids dry and do not soak in water.
• Crafted from upcycled wine bottles. Slight variations in shape, colour and finish are natural. Shades of green may vary depending on bottle availability.
